name: Craft Companion Vehicle
body:
You can craft motorized vehicles.

Prerequisite(s): Technologist, Craft (mechanical) 9 ranks, Knowledge (engineering) 9 ranks

Benefit(s): You can create vehicles based on the companion vehicles presented in this supplement.

Any character with access to the vehicle’s key or other control mechanism may drive and use this vehicle.

Creating a vehicle takes 1 week for every 1,000 gp in the vehicle’s price. To create the object, you must use up raw materials costing half of this total price. See Non-Companion Mechs and Vehicles for more information.

You can repair a broken vehicle if it is one that you could make. Doing so costs half the raw materials and half the time it would take to craft the vehicle from scratch.
